actions.text: Referred to the House Committee on Homeland Security.

official_title: To amend the Homeland Security Act of 2002 to establish within the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency a pilot program to be known as the "BRIDGE AI Mission Program" to recruit and manage artificial intelligence and emerging technology professionals on a temporary basis to support the core mission of the Agency, and for other purposes.
